title.zh: 写实皮肤的细节：毛孔、表皮厚度、粗糙度 vs 文献
title.en: Lifelike skin detail: pores, epidermis thickness, roughness vs the literature

method.zh: 毛孔的密度和面积由生成微细起伏贴图的程序（tools/look/micro.ts，种子固定）直接给出：一块代表 1 cm² 的皮肤。表皮厚度是颜色模型用的值（data/curated/look/skin-colour.json）。粗糙度：部位贴图里的值乘全局倍数 1.4、主瓣再乘 0.75，three 的 GGX α = r²；文献给的是 Torrance–Sparrow 模型的 Beckmann m，这里按 α ≈ m 比较。
method.en: Pore density and area come straight from the program that generates the micro-relief tile (tools/look/micro.ts, fixed seed): one tile stands for 1 cm² of skin. The epidermis thickness is the colour model's value (data/curated/look/skin-colour.json). Roughness: the region map's value times the global factor 1.4, and the main lobe times 0.75 again; three's GGX α = r². The literature gives the Beckmann m of a Torrance–Sparrow model, compared here as α ≈ m.

tolerance.zh: 文献给的是范围时，落在范围内记 within；给的是均值和标准差时，差在 1 SD 内记 within。没有可比测量的项记 not comparable。
tolerance.en: Where the literature gives a range, inside it counts as within; where it gives a mean and SD, a difference within 1 SD counts as within. Items without a comparable measurement are not comparable.

references.name: Flament F et al. 2015, Facial skin pores: a multiethnic study. Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol 8:85–93
references.version: PMC4337418; cheeks of 2,585 women, Dermascore, detection threshold 250 µm: density about 10–80 /cm², mean area 0.03–0.22 mm²
references.clause: Licence field of the Europe PMC record ("cc by-nc"). Only the ranges of density and mean area are cited as numbers.

references.name: Sandby-Møller J, Poulsen T, Wulf HC 2003, Epidermal thickness at different body sites: relationship to age, gender, pigmentation, blood content, skin type and smoking habits. Acta Derm Venereol 83:410–413
references.version: abstract: viable epidermis of the dorsal forearm 56.6 (11.5) µm, stratum corneum 18.3 (4.9) µm, 71 volunteers
references.licence: Not checked; no open licence is assumed
references.clause: No licence grant is relied on. Two numbers of the abstract are cited as facts; the full text was not opened.

references.name: Weyrich T et al. 2006, Analysis of human faces using a measurement-based skin reflectance model. ACM Trans Graph 25(3):1013–1024
references.version: authors' copy (cseweb.ucsd.edu/~henrik/papers/skin-analysis/); Fig. 15: Torrance–Sparrow parameters per face region, 149 subjects
references.clause: No licence grant; only the range of the roughness axis in Fig. 15 is read and cited as a fact.

notes.zh: 毛孔按 10 mm 见方的一块统计；同一块贴图在面部和身体上平铺，所以整张脸的毛孔数随面积成比例。
notes.en: Pores are counted on one 10 mm square tile; the same tile is repeated over the face and body, so the number of pores on a whole face scales with its area.

rows.quantity: pores per cm² in the micro-relief tile

note.zh: 参照是 2,585 名女性颊部的范围（中点 ± 半宽）
note.en: the reference is the range over the cheeks of 2,585 women (midpoint ± half-width)
